mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msds_main WHERE is_active = 1) as totalMsds, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) FROM msds_main m LEFT JOIN msds_hazard h ON m.id = h.msds_id WHERE m.is_active = 1 AND (h.warning_word = 'danger' OR h.hazard_category LIKE '%毒害%')) as highHazardCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msds_document_access_log WHERE DATE_FORMAT(access_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')) as monthlyVisits, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM msds_document_access_log WHERE access_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) as activeUsers

SELECT DATE(access_time) as date, COUNT(*) as visits, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as uniqueUsers, SUM(CASE WHEN access_type = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as viewCount, SUM(CASE WHEN access_type = 'download' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as downloadCount FROM msds_document_access_log WHERE access_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(access_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT c.category_code as code, c.category_name as name, COUNT(m.id) as value, COUNT(m.id) as count, ROUND(COUNT(m.id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msds_main WHERE is_active=1), 2) as percentage FROM msds_main m LEFT JOIN chemical_category c ON m.category_id = c.id WHERE m.is_active = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.category_code, c.category_name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN h.warning_word = 'danger' OR h.hazard_category LIKE '%毒害%' THEN '高危' WHEN h.warning_word = 'warning' OR h.hazard_category LIKE '%腐蚀%' OR h.hazard_category LIKE '%易燃%' THEN '中等' ELSE '低危' END as level, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) as count, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) as value FROM msds_main m LEFT JOIN msds_hazard h ON m.id = h.msds_id WHERE m.is_active = 1 GROUP BY level ORDER BY FIELD(level, '高危', '中等', '低危')

SELECT m.id, m.product_name as productName, m.product_english_name as englishName, m.cas_number as casNumber, CASE WHEN h.warning_word = 'danger' OR h.hazard_category LIKE '%毒害%' THEN 'high' WHEN h.warning_word = 'warning' OR h.hazard_category LIKE '%腐蚀%' OR h.hazard_category LIKE '%易燃%' THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END as hazardLevel, CASE WHEN h.warning_word = 'danger' OR h.hazard_category LIKE '%毒害%' THEN '高危' WHEN h.warning_word = 'warning' OR h.hazard_category LIKE '%腐蚀%' OR h.hazard_category LIKE '%易燃%' THEN '中等' ELSE '低危' END as hazardLevelText, s.view_count as viewCount, s.download_count as downloadCount, s.favorite_count as favoriteCount, 0 as growthRate FROM msds_main m LEFT JOIN msds_document_statistics s ON m.id = s.msds_id LEFT JOIN msds_hazard h ON m.id = h.msds_id WHERE m.is_active = 1 ORDER BY s.view_count DESC, s.download_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m月') as monthLabel, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(*) as value FROM msds_main WHERE is_active = 1 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY month, monthLabel ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM msds_document_access_log WHERE DATE(access_time) = CURDATE()) as dailyActiveUsers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM msds_document_access_log WHERE access_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) as weeklyActiveUsers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM msds_document_access_log WHERE access_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) as monthlyActiveUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE del_flag = '0') as totalUsers
